40:
41: env:
42:   # The ontomark CLI (DreamLab-AI/ontomark, MIT OR Apache-2.0) is the only
43:   # producer of the machine artefacts and the content staging tree. It comes from
44:   # a release, pinned twice: by tag, so a new version is a reviewed change to this
45:   # file, and by digest, so a replaced or tampered asset fails before it runs.
46:   # There is no build-from-source fallback: a run that cannot obtain the pinned
47:   # release fails, because nothing else produces the site's artefacts.
48:   ONTOMARK_RELEASE_REPO: DreamLab-AI/ontomark
49:   ONTOMARK_RELEASE_TAG: v0.7.0             # the release tag, e.g. v0.1.0
50:   ONTOMARK_ASSET: ontomark-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
51:   ONTOMARK_SHA256: 2b814b0423026540db96877b844f13663a787c509cb6632b94980270ef072b4a             # sha256 of ONTOMARK_ASSET at ONTOMARK_RELEASE_TAG
52:
147:       - name: ontomark build → artefacts + content staging
148:         run: |
149:           command -v ontomark >/dev/null || { echo "::error::ontomark not on PATH"; exit 1; }
150:           ontomark --version
151:
152:           rm -rf site-data quartz/content
153:           mkdir -p site-data
154:
155:           # --out            the machine artefacts (contract C3), published at
156:           #                  the SITE ROOT beside the explorer.
157:           # --publish-out    the CONTENT STAGING tree Quartz builds /notes/ from
158:           #                  (owner decision Q16): knowledge/ union the public
159:           #                  half of working/, laid out as pages/** and working/**.
160:           # --with-markdown-mirror  api/markdown/<Title>.md, the explorer's page
161:           #                  body source (pageService.ts). Required.
162:           # --vault all is NOT optional. It defaults to `knowledge` (the parser
163:           # now rejects any other value, but the default stays): "it looks like
164:           # it did what you asked".
165:           # Without it this workflow publishes 8,432 pages instead of 8,625 and
166:           # every gate below stays green, because the staging tree it compares
167:           # against would be knowledge-only as well.
168:           # --certificate-out  the RDFS derivation certificate of the very graph
169:           #                  this build publishes (ontomark ADR-OM-009): every
170:           #                  inferred triple with its rule and premises, in the
171:           #                  oo-cert/1 format. The build is REFUSED (exit 2) if
172:           #                  the certificate does not cover the classifier's
173:           #                  closure, so no generation ships without its warrant.
174:           mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/certificate"
175:           ontomark build \
176:             --vault all \
177:             --out site-data \
178:             --publish-out quartz/content \
179:             --with-markdown-mirror \
180:             --certificate-out "$RUNNER_TEMP/certificate" \
181:             --stats
182:
183:           # Contract C3 places the staging tree at <out>/publish/ when
184:           # --publish-out is absent. It must never reach the site root: it is
185:           # raw markdown, including pages the explorer does not index.
186:           if [ -d site-data/publish ]; then
187:             rm -rf quartz/content
188:             mv site-data/publish quartz/content
189:           fi
